title: Happy Friends Embracing on Wooden Pier, 1940s B&W Deckle Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical deckle-edge snapshot capturing a young woman standing between two smiling young men along a wooden pier or boardwalk. The trio poses affectionately arm-in-arm, dressed in typical post-WWII summer attire, including short-sleeved open-collar shirts, dark high-waisted trousers, and a simple day dress. Utility poles and other strolling pedestrians can be seen along the deck in the bright, slightly overexposed background.
